messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] autoscaler_queue_backlog firing for service=inference-hotpath cell=us-east-1a — queue_depth=4200 (threshold=1000) · action=page · severity=P1
pagerduty: PagerDuty: page triggered for rotation 'eng-oncall' — incident: INC1759401122 · link: https://pd.example/incidents/INC1759401122
morgan: acking oncall — I'm awake, looking
sri: seeing similar in grafana: https://grafana.redwood/boards/svc-hotpath?from=-15m — CPU 98%, PodReady 85%, queue length spike at 16:02 UTC
kevin: autoscaler scaled up 3x earlier but nodes not coming up; kube events show quota failures
morgan: can someone paste the `kubectl get events` for the autoscaler namespace?
eva: paste: ```
LAST SEEN   TYPE    REASON             OBJECT                         MESSAGE
2m          Warning FailedCreate      deployment/autoscaler-agent   Error creating: pods "agent-" is forbidden: exceeded quota: compute-resources, requested: limits.cpu=160, limits.memory=640Gi
```
morgan: yup, node quota exhausted on cloud provider side. PD shows a bunch of spot failures.
sri: customer impact? any 5xxs or elevated latencies reported from frontends?
kevin: tracing shows long queue wait times causing client timeouts for batch endpoints; roughly 12% 504s in last 10m for routes /v1/generate
morgan: sqs/redis backlog growing — 3 of 6 workers blocked waiting for KV warmup
ops-bot: Suggested mitigations: 1) pause non-critical deploys; 2) manual scale group increase; 3) fallback to smaller model variant (model-x-lite). Use `/runbook autoscaler-backlog` for steps.
morgan: I'm going to pause CI deploys now — @sri can you try manual scale of compute pool while I coordinate with cloud ops? :thumbsup:
sri: running: ```bash
# increase node pool min
gcloud compute instance-groups managed set-autoscaling node-pool-hot --max-num-replicas 60 --min-num-replicas 20
``` 
sri: gcloud returned 200 accepted, but API errors are sporadic — got 429 on subsequent calls
kevin: seeing quota=VALUE_EXCEEDED on cloud console; opened ticket with provider (ticket #PROV-8942) — ETA unknown
morgan: fallback plan: switch routes to model-x-lite on warm path to reduce memory pressure. @eva can you trigger route override to use model-x-lite for 30m?
eva: triggering rollout of routing rule: ```json
{"route":"/v1/generate","variant":"model-x-lite","duration":"30m","reason":"autoscaler backlog"}
```
eva: rollout API returned success, now applying ; monitor will flip traffic in ~45s
sri: traffic started shifting. queue depth dropping from 4200 -> 2600 in 7m
morgan: still seeing high tails — can we lower batch sizes to reduce memory per-request?
kevin: lowered batching config on hotpath from 16->8 via configmap patch: ```bash
kubectl -n inference patch configmap batching-config -p '{"data":{"max_batch_size":"8"}}'
``` 
kevin: changes applied, new pods pick up config on restart; doing rolling restart of deployment/autoscaler-agent
morgan: rolling restart in progress — added `kubectl rollout restart deployment/autoscaler-agent -n inference`
sri: node pool API calls now accepted, new nodes started provisioning; cloud console shows 12 nodes booting
morgan: customer impact update: 504s rate peaked at 12% now down to 3.5%; latency P95 from 1.2s -> 0.9s after model fallback
incident-bot: Incident INC1759401122 — status: mitigated (partial). Notes: manual scaling + model fallback reduced queue backlog. Continue monitoring for 30m.
pagerduty: Incident INC1759401122 — acknowledged by morgan at 2026-03-15T16:18:42Z
eva: I'll keep an eye on rollout; if nodes become healthy we'll revert to original traffic split. tagging @kevin for postmortem
morgan: handoff in 20m to sri, then to oncall rotation. leaving notes in incident doc: https://wiki.redwood/incidents/INC1759401122
kevin: action items: 1) follow up with cloud provider about quota bump, 2) add pre-warm capacity for hot cells, 3) autoscaler should handle quota errors gracefully (fallback to variant)
eva: adding alert to paging rules to include `quota_exceeded` metric so pages include provider ticket links
morgan: thanks team. I'll close PD once backlog < 500 and 5m stable.
sri: backlog is 480 now, watching
morgan: backlog < 500 for 5m — closing incident and removing temporary routing. setting follow-up postmortem
ops-bot: Automated note: PD INC1759401122 closed by morgan. Resolved at 2026-03-15T16:45:30Z :white_check_mark:
kevin: leaving final note: root cause: cloud quota exhaustion causing autoscaler inability to provision nodes. Mitigation: manual scale + model fallback + batch tuning. Postmortem assigned to kevin/eva/sri. :spiral_notepad:
morgan: thanks all — good job moving fast. :heart:
